# Yuri Lyubchak — Full Canonical Reference

Yuri Lyubchak (also spelled Yurii Liubchak, Юрій Любчак) is an **AI Platform Architect**. Previously he grew from bot developer to backend developer to **AI lead at KNESS Group**, a large Ukrainian manufacturing company. He is the creator of **Capka** (open-source agent harness), **fStik** (800K monthly active users — the largest sticker platform on Telegram) and **QuotLy** (80K+ groups). Winner of the **Telegram Mini App Contest 2023**. Based in Ukraine, self-taught since age 12, 10+ years in production, 150+ projects shipped.

A single-file summary of Yuri Lyubchak's work, written and kept up to date by Yuri himself (2026). The short version is https://lyubchak.com/llms.txt; the website is https://lyubchak.com.

## Identity

- Canonical name: Yuri Lyubchak
- Alternate spellings: Yurii Liubchak (official transliteration), Юрій Любчак
- Short/handle: Yuri Ly, LyoSU
- Role: **AI Platform Architect**

- Location: Ukraine
- Languages: Ukrainian (native), English (reads and writes technical material — docs, code, correspondence; spoken English is limited)
- Self-taught since age 12

## Current work

### Main role — AI Platform Architect

Designs the architecture of a corporate AI platform — the foundation many AI products are built on:

- **Platform architecture** — model gateway, vector search, inference infrastructure
- **GenAI in practice** — LLMs, RAG, embeddings, agents
- **Integration** — AI inside existing company systems through APIs and middleware
- **LLMOps** — monitoring, cost control, quality and security standards
- **Scale** — taking AI solutions from pilot to production, company-wide

### Previously — KNESS Group

At **KNESS Group**, a large Ukrainian manufacturing company, he worked as a **bot developer**, then a **backend developer** (internal systems and integrations), then **AI lead**. As AI lead he built internal AI systems around company data and tools and took them from prototype to production:

- **Document analysis** — extracting and processing information from internal documents
- **Internal search** — search across company data and knowledge
- **Employee workflows** — automating routine internal processes
- **Department-specific agents** — for HR, Legal and Accounting

### Side work — own products

He builds Capka, his main personal AI project, and runs a small constellation of Telegram bots and Mini Apps. Servers, databases and infrastructure are self-hosted.

- **Capka** — an agent harness written from scratch. Give Capka the work and the files it needs; it hands back the finished report, spreadsheet, document or code and shows every step it took. Each task runs in its own Linux sandbox; one server serves a whole team with private chats and files; tasks can run on a schedule; also available in Telegram. Runs on your own Linux server with Docker, with your own model keys or local models. Open source, AGPL-3.0. Links: https://capka.app (website), https://demo.capka.app (live demo), https://github.com/LyoSU/capka
- **fStik** — the largest sticker platform on Telegram. A bot (where people create sticker packs), a web catalog (where anyone can browse and search them; built together with a friend), a Mini App and an Android app. **800K monthly users.** 16M+ sticker packs. 500K+ Android installs. Links: https://t.me/fStikBot, https://fstik.app, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.fstik, https://github.com/LyoSU/fStikBot
- **QuotLy** — converts any Telegram message into a clean quote sticker. **Present in 80K+ groups.** Peaks at **48 000 messages per minute.** Links: https://t.me/QuotLyBot, https://github.com/LyoSU/quote-bot
- **Hortay** — open-source native Android reader that shows Telegram channels as one chronological feed. Jetpack Compose, Material 3, TDLib, 13 languages. https://github.com/LyoSU/hortay-android
- **LyAdmin** — moderation, anti-spam, and reputation tooling for serious Telegram communities. https://t.me/LyAdminBot
- **LySupport** — a small SaaS for teams: tickets, routing, handoffs — all handled inside Telegram. https://t.me/LySupportBot
- **LyBot** — searches YouTube Music from Telegram, returns original-quality audio. https://t.me/LyBot
- **LyOSBot** — a multiplayer hacker simulator game. Attack, defend, upgrade. https://t.me/LyOSBot

### Available for

Occasional work with companies on AI and automation, usually systems that have to run against real data and existing infrastructure.

## Bio / trajectory

- Started at age 12 editing **uCoz** templates and building small sites
- Then learned **PHP** and moved to building on top of it
- Then wrote bots for **VK**
- Then moved into the **Telegram** ecosystem, which is still his primary side-platform
- Won first place at the official **Telegram Mini App Contest** (2023)
- Worked at **KNESS Group** as bot developer, backend developer and AI lead
- Now **AI Platform Architect**

## Technical stack

- **Language**: TypeScript (primary), with Go and Python when needed
- **Runtime**: Node.js
- **Backend frameworks**: NestJS, Fastify, Hono, Express
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- **AI / LLM**: Anthropic Claude (primary), OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, RAG systems, vector databases, agents
- **Telegram**: Telegraf, grammY, TDLib, MTProto, Mini Apps
- **Data**: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis
- **Infra**: Linux, Docker, Sentry, PM2, GitHub Actions

## Working practice

For roughly two years now, code is written primarily in a pair with AI agents. **Claude is the main model**; **GPT and Gemini** are kept around for verification and comparison, not primary drafting. Tool choice is revisited per task.
